class_name: 推量-不確実-カモシレナイ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1: author → mechanical attachment gate → cold review → fixes applied → gate re-run

patterns.usage_note: The default hedge for a possibility the speaker considers real but unconfirmed; weaker and more tentative than だろう. It follows plain forms directly, and after a noun or na-adjective the copula だ drops (雨かもしれない, 静かかもしれない). Clipping it to かも is casual speech; the sibling かもわからない is a colloquial substitute many speakers avoid in writing.

examples.ruby: その話[はなし]、ただの噂[うわさ]かもしれないよ。
examples.english: That story might be nothing but a rumor, you know.

examples.ruby: 急[いそ]げば最終[さいしゅう]バスに間[ま]に合[あ]うかもしれない。
examples.english: If we hurry we might still make the last bus.

examples.ruby: 傘[かさ]は電車[でんしゃ]の中[なか]に置[お]き忘[わす]れたかもしれません。
examples.english: I may have left my umbrella behind on the train.

patterns.usage_note: A colloquial variant of かもしれない built on 分かる instead of 知れる. It is heard mainly in speech, noticeably in Kansai and from older speakers, and enough people treat it as non-standard that it is best kept out of writing. Semantically it is simply かもしれない — the difference is register and region, not nuance; the contracted かもわからん is especially common.

examples.ruby: あの店[みせ]、この時間[じかん]だともう閉[し]まっているかもわからない。
examples.english: That shop may well be shut already at this hour.

examples.ruby: 今年[ことし]の冬[ふゆ]は思[おも]ったより寒[さむ]いかもわからん。
examples.english: This winter could turn out colder than we figured.

examples.ruby: 犯人[はんにん]は案外[あんがい]身近[みぢか]な人物[じんぶつ]かもわからないぞ。
examples.english: The culprit might just be someone close to us.
